svg.title: Unlabeled slow-subspace recovery: sampling noise and residual spectral bias
svg.desc: evidence_tier: exploratory_numerical_sandbox; seed=2026111601; paired descriptive numerical sandbox; no neural-network experiment
svg.text: Unlabeled slow-subspace recovery: sampling noise and residual spectral bias
Ncal=1024 independent trajectories x 193 states; 3 CAL replicates; color = mean signal-loading subspace angle.
Slow AR(.94) noise on fast axes | lag=1
Slow AR(.94) noise on fast axes | lag=4
Slow AR(.94) noise on fast axes | lag=16
R is signal power, not MSE-based state R2. Angles use oracle physical coordinates; eigenvector fitting uses no labels.
Independent residual rates: all .5 (top) or [.5,.5,.94,.94] (bottom). Finite-sample transitions need not coincide exactly with population boundaries.
